if not ZbsDir then return end

local zbsDir = ZbsDir or ""
local emmyCoreDll = string.format("%s/emmy/%s/%s%s"
, zbsDir
, IsWin and "windows" or "mac"
, IsWin and (Is64 and "x64/" or "x86/") or ""
, IsWin and "?.dll" or "?.dylib")

print("debug=====emmy_core===========>", zbsDir, emmyCoreDll)

package.cpath = package.cpath .. ";" .. emmyCoreDll
local dbg = require('emmy_core')
local ret,msg = pcall(function() dbg.tcpConnect("localhost", "9966") end)
print("connect to debugger===========>", ret ,msg)
